definition:
• **Regression**: Predicts a continuous numerical value (e.g., house price, sales totals, temperature).
• **Classification**: Predicts a discrete categorical label (e.g., binary: spam/not spam, multiclass: penguin species).
• **Clustering**: Unsupervised grouping of similar items without prior labels (e.g., customer segmentation).
examTip: Predicting daily sales or weather temperature = **Regression**. Predicting whether a customer churns (Yes/No) = **Binary Classification**.

term: Image Classification vs. Object Detection vs. OCR
definition:
• **Image Classification**: Evaluates the entire image and returns category tags with confidence scores.
• **Object Detection**: Identifies multiple objects in an image AND provides their coordinates (bounding boxes).
• **Optical Character Recognition (OCR / Read API)**: Extracts printed and handwritten text from images, receipts, and PDFs.
examTip: If an answer requires locating where a vehicle is in an image, select **Object Detection** (bounding box coordinates).

term: Azure AI Language & Azure AI Speech
definition:
• **Azure AI Language**: Key phrase extraction, entity recognition (NER), sentiment analysis, conversational language understanding (CLU), and question answering.
• **Azure AI Speech**: Speech-to-text (transcription), text-to-speech (custom neural voice), and real-time speech translation.
examTip: To extract names of people, locations, and organizations from contracts, use **Named Entity Recognition (NER)** in Azure AI Language.

definition:
• **Fairness**: AI systems should treat all people fairly.
• **Reliability & Safety**: AI systems should perform reliably and safely under expected and unexpected conditions.
• **Privacy & Security**: AI systems should be secure and respect data privacy.
• **Inclusiveness**: AI systems should empower everyone and engage people.
• **Transparency**: AI systems should be understandable (explainability).
• **Accountability**: People must be accountable for how AI systems operate.
examTip: Ensure a loan approval model does not discriminate based on race, gender, or age = **Fairness**. Providing audit logs and human oversight = **Accountability**.
